METROPOLITAN POLICE DEPARTMENT ? TRAFFIC INVESTIGATION DIVISION
MOTOR VEHICLE ACCIDENT & INCIDENT REPORT
INCIDENT REPORT NUMBER: CAD-2026-88192
DATE OF INCIDENT: October 14, 2026
TIME OF CALL: 16:32 HOURS (4:32 PM)
INCIDENT LOCATION: Intersection of Grand Avenue and 5th Street
INVESTIGATING OFFICER:
Officer Marcus Vance | Badge Number: #714 | Precinct: Central Division 3
INVOLVED VEHICLES & PARTIES:
Vehicle 1 (Insured):
- Driver: Jordan Lee
- Vehicle: 2023 Tesla Model Y (Plate: DEMO-4821)
- Insurance: Aegis Shield Mutual (Policy: POL-AEGIS-2026-9844)
- Travel Direction: Eastbound on Grand Avenue with green signal
Vehicle 2 (At-Fault Party):
- Driver: Robert Hayes (Commercial Van Logistics)
- Vehicle: 2021 Ford Transit Cargo Van (Plate: COMM-9014)
- Insurance: Metro Commercial Express Insurance (Policy: COM-7721)
- Travel Direction: Westbound turning left onto 5th Street
OFFICER NARRATIVE OF OCCURRENCE:
Officer Vance responded to a two-vehicle collision at Grand Avenue and 5th Street. Physical roadway evidence and witness
statements confirm Vehicle 1 was traveling eastbound through the intersection under a solid green traffic light. Vehicle 2
attempted an unprotected left turn on a flashing yellow arrow across Vehicle 1's path of travel without yielding right-of-way.
Vehicle 1 attempted collision avoidance braking but was unable to clear Vehicle 2. Vehicle 2's front bumper struck the
front-right bumper, headlight, and crossmember of Vehicle 1.
DAMAGES & INJURIES:
- Vehicle 1: Severe front-right collision damage, crushed right headlamp, deployed bumper fascia. Towed from scene by Metro
Towing.
- Vehicle 2: Left quarter panel and bumper scrape. Drivable.
- Injuries: No immediate emergency transport required. Drivers complained of minor seatbelt shoulder soreness.
CITATION & FAULT DETERMINATION:
Vehicle 2 driver (Robert Hayes) cited for Failure to Yield Right of Way while turning left (Violation Code: MVC 21801-A).
Primary fault assigned to Vehicle 2.
